claim_scope: Complete rooted b-ary trees for integer b>=2 and h>=1; exactly one edge-open-packing optimum.
integrity: Mathematical induction is primary evidence; the executable tests finite instances only. No independent assessment has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Does not cover irregular or partially filled trees. General linear-time tree algorithm is prior work. Foundational 2022 full publisher version was inaccessible; equivalent unindexed result remains possible.
title: Period-three rigidity of maximum edge open packings in complete rooted trees
